name: Internet-Native Payments (x402 V2, Solana devnet)
summary: Charge for API endpoints with x402 V2 and pay for them with a devnet wallet. Test money only.

env.note: Your Solana devnet wallet address. Payments to your paid endpoints arrive here.
CAIP-2 id. Only Solana devnet is allowed by this template.
Free public test facilitator: verifies + settles devnet payments and pays the SOL fees.
DEVNET-ONLY throwaway key for the paying side (buyer). Base58 or solana-keygen JSON array. Never commit.
Optional devnet RPC used when building payments.

prerequisites: A Solana devnet address to receive test payments (PAY_TO_ADDRESS); `python -m agent keygen --pay-to` makes one
To pay: a throwaway devnet keypair (`python -m agent keygen`) funded with devnet USDC from https://faucet.circle.com (no real money)
The receiving address also needs a devnet USDC token account: send it faucet USDC once
